title: QH 207 physical-data provenance + bronze surface/patina intent killer gate

QH207_2014_imaging_state.finding: The 2014 imaging paper states that QH 207/39 and QH 207/55 were among objects not CT-scanned in that phase and were assessed from the 1970 radiographs; QH 207/38 was also documented by radiography.
QH207_2014_imaging_state.interpretation: This is a chronology marker, not proof that later CT never occurred.

QH207_later_muct_state.finding: The 2015 ICA poster publicly shows µCT/3D work for QH 207/39 and QH 207/40, including segmentation and surface extraction workflow; the 2016 volume discusses metal-artifact effects in CT data for QH 207/39 and QH 207/55 as well as other objects.

QH207_38_32_archive_state.finding: The 2016 catalogue reports original excavation/object photographs and a recovered set of historical radiographs. QH 207/38 and QH 207/32 were not in Bonn in 2016 and their whereabouts were unknown; the radiograph-card history and object photos remain a viable physical-association test route.

QH207_2022_ritual_hypothesis.finding: The 2022 BIFAO paper explicitly presents the local ritual model as a new hypothesis. It connects the QH207 feet to Elephantine/First Cataract Osirian leg theology but frames the conclusion as possible ritual employment and contrasts it with technological-feasibility alternatives.

osiris_green_symbolism.finding: Museum sources consistently identify green Osiris skin as a symbol of regeneration, fertility and renewed life; black is also an established Osirian colour.

bronze_green_corrosion.finding: Green corrosion on archaeological Egyptian copper alloys commonly includes malachite, atacamite, clinoatacamite and related copper compounds. A published bronze Osiris case explicitly notes that the present green corrosion is visually appropriate to Osiris symbolism but was not the object's original colour because the figure had originally been gilded.

intentional_patination_controls.finding: Analytical studies demonstrate intentional black patination on some ancient Egyptian copper alloys, including thermal tenorite-rich surfaces and organic coatings. This establishes that intentional colour engineering of copper-alloy surfaces existed, but does not establish intentional green patination for QH207.

required: original µCT projection data if preserved
MAR and non-MAR reconstructions if both survive
scan metadata, voxel size, energy, detector geometry, acquisition date
full-resolution surface/HDR microscopy associated with gilding

QH207_39.resolved_publicly: later µCT existence supported after the earlier 2014 radiograph-only phase
required: exact date and provenance of later µCT campaign
1970 radiographs and cards as chronological control

QH207_55.resolved_publicly: later µCT existence supported by 2016 CT metal-artifact discussion, superseding the earlier 2014 radiograph-only state
required: exact CT campaign date and acquisition metadata
original radiographs at full available resolution
original object/excavation photograph at full available resolution

physical_data_gate_v2.promotion_rule: Only geometry, break-surface correspondence, original surface-treatment evidence, analytical stratigraphy, or archive custody evidence may advance physical gates. Expert agreement alone is REVIEW_FEEDBACK.

green_surface_intent_gate.name: QH207_GREEN_OSIRIS_SURFACE_INTENT_GATE
test_sequence: Acquire full-resolution visible/HDR/microscope imagery before interpretation.
Map present green/blue/black/red/brown surface zones object-by-object.
Use non-destructive Raman/XRD/micro-XRF where possible to identify malachite, atacamite/paratacamite, cuprite, tenorite and residual gilding/coatings.
Where ethically available from existing samples only, use SEM-EDS/cross-section evidence to establish layer order: bronze -> original finish/coating -> corrosion products.
Compare Osiris fragments against non-Osiris copper-alloy controls from the same assemblage and against external Egyptian bronze controls.
Require selective or stratigraphically ancient colour treatment before any symbolic-intent promotion.

decision_states.NATURAL_LATE_CORROSION: No promotion; colour is post-depositional/conservation history.
decision_states.ANCIENT_INTENTIONAL_BLACK_SURFACE: Material-symbolic possibility, but not green-Osiris evidence by itself.
decision_states.ANCIENT_INTENTIONAL_GREEN_SURFACE: Advance to selective-pattern and chronology tests; still not proof bronze was chosen because Osiris is green.
decision_states.ANCIENT_INTENTIONAL_GREEN_SURFACE_SELECT: Strong material-symbolic signal requiring independent replication and context controls.
decision_states.ORIGINAL_GILDING_UNDER_GREEN_CORROSION: Direct negative control against treating current green as intended original appearance.

questions: surface/patina analytical datasets beyond published gilding

new_outreach.anti_duplicate: No duplicate follow-up sent to Willer, Auenmüller or Fitzenreiter while their existing requests are pending.

next_killer_gate.name: QH207_PHYSICAL_AND_SURFACE_EVIDENCE_FREEZE_V1
next_killer_gate.trigger: Any raw CT, reconstructed volume, segmentation, STL, radiograph, original negative, surface-analysis file, sample report or archive identifier is received.
procedure: Freeze original bytes before semantic interpretation.
Record filename, sender/custodian, provenance, acquisition date, instrument metadata and checksum where possible.
Run object-identity verification before geometry or chemistry analysis.
Keep physical-data verdict separate from ritual interpretation.
Do not promote QH207_TO_ELEPHANTINE_RELIC_RITUAL_CAUSAL_LINK from expert opinion alone.
